parsed.rationale: One of the two participating records lives at 'Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift', which is under an Examples/SampleApp path. The other record lives in the production package 'DebugPanel' at 'Shared/DebugPanel/Sources/DebugPanel/DebugMetricsProvider.swift'. This is the canonical mixed-cluster restraint pattern: the name collision between the two `type-alias-object` declarations for `DisplayLinkSequence.AsyncIterator` is incidental to their separate contexts. Merging or extracting a shared definition would couple production DebugPanel semantics to sample-app demonstration code, which is the exact coupling the restraint rule is designed to prevent.
